findings.title: Non-increase is not strict descent
findings.detail: Phi(after)<=Phi(before) admits equality, whereas strict descent requires <. Calling these the same obscures stationary steps and termination arguments. Constant positive Phi is an immediate counterexample to strict progress.
findings.action: Use non-increase/monotonicity for <=; state a separate strict-progress or stationary/refusal rule and any well-founded termination assumptions.

findings.title: Survivor-product analytic bound needs a unit-disk condition
findings.detail: The stated a_d<=C M^d and |z|<1/M do not suffice if 0<M<1. One degree-one generator satisfies the bound with C=2,M=1/2, but its geometric series diverges at z=3/2 despite |z|<2. The formal Euler product remains valid.
findings.action: Declare M>=1, replace it by max(1,M), or require |z|<min(1,1/M).

findings.title: EIS educational implementation contradicts its exact-affinity curriculum
findings.detail: The level prohibits arbitrary float boosts; the companion returns floating token-overlap ratios and raises affinity_threshold by 0.05. Its tests validate that boost. These classes cannot serve as executable evidence for the rational P/(P+F) specification.
findings.action: Either align the companion with exact counts/Fraction and candidate custody, or label it explicitly as a separate synthetic simulation and remove verification equivalence claims.

findings.title: Teaching admission example checks digest equality, not human authentication
findings.detail: The displayed gateway returns True after a hash comparison without checking signer trust, signature, status or scope. The local companion runs only size/keyword screening and never invokes its stored thymus. This does not support the page's absolute cryptographic fencing claim. Production authenticated.rs is a different path and was separately reviewed by the parent team; this finding is not a production signature-bypass claim.
findings.action: Show the complete trusted-verifier/role/scope/time/custody binding path or mark the fragment as digest binding only and link the actual authenticated owner and negative tests.

findings.title: Education Lean kernels prove local definitions, not broad advertised properties
findings.detail: EIS proves exact equality self-match rejection, a Boolean danger gate and a constant None field. It does not verify semantic detection, independent danger origin or stabilization. PCIV proves Pareto irreflexivity and new-ID assignment; the split-retraction comment is not a retraction theorem, LineageEdge has no proof field, and verifyClaimReceipt ignores its free-text narrowestClaim. Successful elaboration validates these narrower propositions only.
findings.action: Map each theorem to its exact exported proposition; separate predicates/structures from proved invariants and remove claims of unrestricted semantic hygiene or stability.

findings.title: Educational evolution manufactures performance gains
findings.detail: retro_inherit changes correctness by +0.05 and latency by a 0.95 factor without checker execution, even for an empty reflection that leaves the genotype unchanged. The test explicitly expects improved correctness. The master specification correctly says efficacy is NOT_MEASURED; the companion must not be used as evidence of adaptation.
findings.action: Keep unevaluated child metrics missing until actual independent evaluation, or label fabricated metrics as synthetic dynamics in every consuming lesson and plot.

findings.title: Distinct labels and graph nonadjacency are not established evidential independence
findings.detail: The companion counts distinct arbitrary strings. The richer curriculum defines independence through absence of four selected key equalities in a correlation graph. MIS is valid combinatorics on that graph, but absence of a recorded key collision does not establish causal or statistical independence or eliminate unmodeled shared causes.
findings.action: Call the count policy-relative support; bind host-derived provenance and causal dedup in the executable companion, and separately validate any real-world independence assumptions.

findings.title: Prompt-tree wiki repeats the unestablished global-null operad quotient
findings.detail: A single null object across different colored input/output profiles does not define the claimed colored-operad quotient without profile-indexed zero terms. Ill-typed grafts are not already elements of the free well-typed operad. Existing support audit also reproduced a unary+nullary graft retaining unary inputs. This page presents Theorem3 as settled rather than identifying the missing typed construction. Retry probability likewise needs conditional/independence assumptions and a positive-admission condition for conditional purity.
findings.action: State a profile-indexed absorbing rejection construction, prove hereditary invalidity for the declared defect predicate, fix graft boundary substitution, and make probability hypotheses explicit.

findings.title: The educational event log is not a durable recovery implementation
findings.detail: The companion is an in-memory mutable list. verify_integrity does not compare the computed tip with last_hash, so removing the final event still passes. The curriculum's crash-consistency guarantee needs atomic commit, flush/recovery and concurrency assumptions in addition to hashes/CAS; it is not established by this companion.
findings.action: Label the chain as an educational prefix-integrity model; validate the tip against an independently retained anchor and reference actual durable transaction/recovery tests for stronger claims.

findings.title: Inverse-rank and ecological companions omit advertised contracts
findings.detail: The educational ranker has no child pass-fraction input, no exact rational certificate and no distinct-descendant evidence dedup. IslandEcology stores capacity but does not enforce it. These are different models from the named curriculum mechanisms, not complete executable witnesses.
findings.action: Document exact omissions or wire the declared certified rank/capacity contracts into lessons. Do not interpret normalized floating rank as measured ancestral utility or authority.

findings.title: Proof ledger ending contradicts its historical/current-source warning
findings.detail: The opening correctly says Paper043.lean is absent and historical PASS rows are not current evidence. The final narrowest claim nevertheless says all50 theorems in that file compile, and section5 is not covered by the opening's explicit historical Sections1-to4 label. This risks lifting an archived summary into present proof status.
findings.action: Label every inherited conclusion historical and replace the final claim with exact current roots, exported types, build receipt and axiom census; retain the old record as history.

findings.title: Rubric conflicts on score tokens when a gate is unassessed
findings.detail: Section1.4 says any incomplete assessment has null composite/token while preserving a known E finding. Scenario4 and calibration row4 assign L3E with G4=null. This is a policy consistency issue, not a mathematical finding about code quality.
findings.action: Keep a separate known-failure ceiling/finding with incomplete composite=null, or explicitly define a distinct incomplete-failure token and ensure machine records use it consistently.
